Name: WIP_Complete
Description: Set the rig scene to WIP or Complete mode

attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Sets the rig scene to WIP or Complete mode, mirroring the Helpers UI buttons.

How To Use:
  Set Mode to WIP or COMPLETE then build the block.

Fields:
- Mode: WIP keeps the rig editable and visible. COMPLETE finalises the rig hierarchy, locks geo, tags controllers and hides internal groups.
- Geometry Group: The name of the geometry group to lock/unlock/hide/show (defaults to 'geo').

Tips:
- WIP mode is useful during rigging iterations.
- COMPLETE mode prepares the rig for delivery/animation.
